title: Atelier Mods catalog entry
description: mod.json, beside the package in mods/<id>/ (plugins, themes) or native/<id>/ (native mods).

id.description: Reverse-DNS id. Must equal the folder name and the package's own id.

name.description: Shown on the card. Must equal the package's name.

key.description: Your Ed25519 public key (base64). With it, package.sig must be your signature over the package.

url.description: Your own page, shown on your author page.

author.description: Who made it, as shown: a name, or { name, key, url }.

github.description: Your GitHub handle. Only this account (or a maintainer) may update the mod.

version.description: Semantic version. Must equal the package's version.

kind.description: plugin and theme live in mods/, native in native/.

summary.description: One or two sentences for the card.

description.description: Markdown for the mod page. Or put it in description.md beside mod.json.

screenshots.description: PNG or JPEG files in screenshots/, at least 640 px wide, at most 1.5 MB each. 16:10 looks best.

permissions.description: Plugins only: exactly the permissions in the plugin's manifest.json.

hosts.description: Plugins only: exactly the plugin's network.hosts.

minAtelier.description: The oldest Atelier it works with, like 1.0.0.

homepage.description: Where to learn more, or the source.

license.description: An SPDX licence id, like MIT or Apache-2.0.

changes.description: What changed in this version, for the version history.
